title: Ado's theorem in characteristic zero
abstract: Every finite-dimensional Lie algebra over a field of characteristic zero admits a faithful finite-dimensional representation in which every element of the nilradical acts nilpotently. The development includes Levi complements, Weyl complete reducibility, highest-weight and sl2 infrastructure, and extensions of nilrepresentations across split ideals.

informal.Ado.adoCharZero: Every finite-dimensional Lie algebra over any field of characteristic zero has an injective Lie algebra homomorphism into the endomorphisms of a finite-dimensional vector space.
informal.Ado.exists_faithful_nilrepresentation_ch: The faithful finite-dimensional representation can be chosen so that each element of the nilradical acts as a nilpotent endomorphism.
